blocks.orig: Nestled in the Njiro Area of Arusha City, Mbugwe Lodge is situated in a gateway to Northern Tanzania’s renowned national parks. The apartments lodge spans two acres (8,100 square meters) of lush garden. The lodge apartments, infused with local decor are designed to make you feel at home. Each ensuite apartment has access to room(s), living area, a small kitchen and a veranda.
blocks.html: In the Njiro Area of Arusha City, Mbugwe Lodge lies at a gateway to Northern Tanzania’s well-known national parks. This apartment lodge covers two acres (8,100 square meters) of green garden. Decorated with local touches, the apartments are designed so you feel at home. Every ensuite apartment comes with room(s), a living area, a small kitchen and a veranda.
